scientific_role: deterministic public-source attachment policy; chunk geometry is part of source semantics and is not assumed to be pure transport

chunk_policy.derivation: existing public structural holdout uses 8 cells x 5000 m = 40000 m
chunk_policy.reference_point_rule: sort by grid_row then grid_col; step=max(1,floor(n/8)); take first 8 stepped rows

relationship_to_chunk_invariance_audit.reason: this policy does not claim chunking is pure transport; it freezes one pre-outcome chunk/source-selection convention as part of the source layer
relationship_to_chunk_invariance_audit.if_audit_later_shows_invariance: interpretation may be relaxed to transport-equivalent, but the frozen execution policy does not change
relationship_to_chunk_invariance_audit.if_audit_later_shows_noninvariance: the fixed phase remains the declared source-selection policy; do not choose the more favorable phase

forbidden: do not change chunk phase after seeing terrain values
do not change chunk width after seeing terrain values
do not change GSI source priority
do not drop source-indeterminate fine cells from public source accounting
do not interpret missing terrain as ecological absence
do not compute structural ranking before source-complete terrain attachment is frozen
next_gate: Execute fixed-policy GSI terrain attachment with denominator-preserving source states, freeze per-unit source-completeness and terrain-feature digests, then intersect required source-complete layers before G_E_LOCAL_GRID_V1.
